claims.claim_text: Established a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows through deterministic route-policy dispatch and multi-agent orchestration contracts.
Expanded enterprise AI platform adoption through CFO-aligned adoption motions, connecting workflow value to reusable commercialization and usage-based forecasting.
Strengthened production trust with audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows, supported by evaluation gates, telemetry, and rollback controls.
Accelerated the AI systems lifecycle from six months to three weeks by standardizing managed workflow orchestration from intake through production monitoring.
Built high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms across AWS and Databricks Lakehouse data infrastructure supporting vector services and parallel decision workflows.
Scaled the engineering team from 8 to 28 while commercializing reusable AI platform capability through agentic platform productization and a repeatable operating model.
